steps.prompt: Before the check: which idea from this unit surprised you most?

cards.title: Logic and invariants: quick review
cards.body: To be sure, plan for the worst case: $n(k - 1) + 1$ objects in $n$ boxes force $k$ together. Look for what never changes: totals, parity, remainders and colourings.

cards.title: Games and time: quick review
cards.body: Find losing positions backwards: with "take $1$ to $k$", leave multiples of $k + 1$. Clock angle at $h{:}m$: $|30h - 5.5m|$. Weekdays repeat every $7$ days; century years are leap years only when divisible by $400$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.

prompts: Which habit from this unit will you use first on your next test?
Which skill will you keep practising in the daily review?
